Light mode is readable everywhere, the activity log shows dates, and private container registries are supported.

## Added

- **Private registry support (#106).** Post-backup image updates can now pull from private or sponsor-gated registries (GHCR, Docker Hub, lscr.io, custom hosts). Add your registry credentials under Settings → Storage → Container registries; BombVault picks the matching credential from the image reference automatically and stays anonymous everywhere else. Tokens are stored encrypted, are never echoed back by the API, and can be replaced or removed per registry.
- **Dates in the activity log (#104).** Every log line now carries a locale-aware date next to the time (e.g. "23.07. 05:04:08"), and the filter finds dates too — type an ISO date like 2026-07-23 or the short form shown in the log to see just that day.

## Fixed

- **Light mode is readable again (#105).** Status colours (the green/red/blue/yellow of chips, log lines, banners and badges) were hard-coded for the dark theme and nearly invisible on light backgrounds. All of them now switch with the theme: dark mode is pixel-identical to before, light mode uses proper high-contrast counterparts from the IBM Carbon light palette — including the backup heatmap, whose failure cells were the worst offender.
